reasons.reader_question: The ending makes the cost of an empty rampart concrete: no shout and no witness if she turns toward the bed.
reasons.change: His knowledge grows: her cover deflects, the scars mean childhood use, and she has a will. He also clears the wall above his window.
reasons.romance_movement: The value shift from instrument to person lands for a new reason: the torn trousseau cloth echoes Asha's slate.
reasons.shown_chemistry: Devan's care shows in restraint. Neela gets little responsive exchange with him, and the terrace volley is the only real duet.
reasons.character_logic: Letting the leopard story run is smart. His 'plain reason' for pulling the sentry doesn't follow, because paw-marks don't depend on the sentry.
reasons.stakes_and_cost: He trades his own safety for her freedom from witnesses, sees the risk too late, and refuses to spare her the story.
reasons.prose: Clean and concrete, with no banned phrases. Echoed knuckle images (Muthu pale, Neela white) and an opening that recaps chapter 4 at length.
reasons.continuity: Consistent with chapter 4's ending, F309/F350/F351, the order of protections and Janu's stories stopping in chapter 9.

fixes: At "His first reason was a plain one. Whoever had sent her": character logic. Reading paw-marks by the trough works with or without a sentry, so the reason doesn't explain the order. Replace it with a reason tied to the sentry. A lantern and a shout would drive her to ground or change her route. With the wall bare she runs her true road to her master, and he reads it at dawn.

At "Devan stood with the water pot in his hand": shown chemistry is one-sided. Neela acts but never responds to him. Add one beat before he leaves where she registers his stillness and does something specific. She might hold the torn strip out to him to tie off, or ask if the goat bit him too. He refuses, and that turns his exit into an exchange she can read wrongly.

At "Soft as a dropped cloth, her weight landed": the final line repeats her nightly exit, so the new fear goes unanswered on the page. Before she drops, have her stop on the ledge facing in for a count he can measure. That gives a breath where she could turn toward the bed. End on her going, so his cold thought becomes the reader's uncertainty.
reader_question: Now that Devan has stripped the wall above his window to keep her unwitnessed, will his silence protect Neela or leave him open to her claws?
new_facts_assessment: The draft's new-facts list is empty, but the chapter adds Kunjan Chirayil, Bindu, two years at border school, the dead father, Asha's slate, Muthu as old partner and the saddle-blanket. All are consistent and useful, and continuity already holds them (F060-F069, F309-F313, F350-F351). The empty list is a process miss.
